native_integration.worker: InstalledWorker<M: ConstructionMemory>; native::worker binds canonical NativeMemory to the same worker CPU
native_integration.timer: Canonical Power owns executor ticking exactly once per physical tick. Vendor runtime calls AudioZoomActor::observe under the shared audio lock without ticking the executor again.
native_integration.notifications: Executor I/O owns Notify actions, PostFinished and bank publication actions. Idle and unchanged bank selection use BankNotify/BankNotifyUnchanged; changed-bank roots terminate through BankComplete. The ARM artifact includes canonical audio_bank_residue.S.
native_integration.completion: A successful executor generation retires after its final action. Input stop schedules and retires the second7d15b0 generation before completing. InstalledWorker publishes the authenticated request and terminal phases on host and ARM.
native_integration.scope: Codec request ownership. FFF020 DMA programming, stream setup and stream command state machine belong to the stream owner.
